payload.claim: `_run_for`'s `exclude_keys` is the whole record's set of run-fact keys (`fold.py`'s `run_fact_keys`, built once over every task in the fold, not scoped to this fact's repo or `base_sha`). Every bare task folded builds an `IN (...)` clause sized to that whole-record set and runs it as a subquery, so a fold's cost for bare tasks grows with the total number of run-fact tasks across every repo, not just the ones sharing this row's `base_sha`. The result is still correct (irrelevant keys just fail to match `repo_id`/`base_sha`), but the module's own evidence doc already tracks fold wall-clock at measured task counts (`docs/evidence/2026-09-20-fold-rebuild-time.md`), and this adds an unscoped per-bare-task cost that was not measured.
